name: effectiveEpiStructOfIsColimit
statement: C} (f : Y ⟶ X) (Hf : IsColimit (Sieve.generateSingleton f : Presieve X).cocone) : EffectiveEpiStruct f

have_tree.body: Hf.fac (aux e h) ⟨Over.mk f, 𝟙 _, by simp⟩

name: effectiveEpiFamilyStructOfIsColimit
statement: C} {α : Type*} (X : α → C) (π : (a : α) → (X a ⟶ B)) (H : IsColimit (Sieve.generateFamily X π : Presieve B).cocone) : EffectiveEpiFamilyStruct X π
